tagline.en_US: Runs ChromeOS Flex as a QEMU virtual machine inside a native LXC, downloaded and installed automatically and used from the browser. Community packaging by Dockur.

description.en_US: ChromeOS Flex is a cloud-first, lightweight operating system that provides a fast and secure web-focused desktop environment. It runs the Chrome browser and web applications on standard x86 hardware with minimal resource overhead. Through a virtualized instance, it enables accessing the full ChromeOS interface and ecosystem remotely via a web browser.
